# discovery

```go
import "banyan/discovery"
```

Package discovery provides peer discovery mechanisms for the Banyan network. It implements multiple discovery strategies including Distributed Hash Table \(DHT\) for wide\-area peer discovery, mDNS for local network discovery, and GossipSub\-based lookup requests for finding specific peers.

The package handles peer lookup requests and responses over the gossip network, supports encrypted peer identity exchange, and integrates with the connection manager to establish connections to discovered peers.

<a name="NewManager"></a>
## func [NewManager](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L58>)

```go
func NewManager(host host.Host, ctx context.Context, dht *dht.IpfsDHT, pubsub *pubsub.PubSub, eventBroadcaster interfaces.EventBroadcaster, disableDHT bool, noCrypto bool, anonLookups bool, httpTransport *http.Transport) interfaces.DiscoveryManager
```

NewManager creates a new discovery manager with the given libp2p host, context, DHT instance, pubsub system, event broadcaster, and configuration options. If disableDHT is true, DHT\-based discovery is skipped. If noCrypto is true, encryption is disabled for lookup responses. If anonLookups is false, anonymous lookup requests are ignored.

<a name="Manager"></a>
## type [Manager](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L41-L51>)

Manager coordinates peer discovery using multiple mechanisms. It manages DHT\-based discovery for finding peers in the wider network, mDNS for local network discovery, and GossipSub messaging for peer lookup requests. The manager also handles event broadcasting for discovery\-related notifications.

<a name="Manager.HandleLookupRequest"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [HandleLookupRequest](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L296>)

```go
func (m *Manager) HandleLookupRequest(req *types.LookupRequest, from peer.ID, cryptoManager interfaces.CryptoManager, connectionManager interfaces.PeerManager)
```

HandleLookupRequest processes incoming peer lookup requests from the gossip network. It validates the request, optionally checks for anonymous lookup restrictions, and sends a response containing the peer's public key and optionally encrypted peer ID back to the requester.

<a name="Manager.ProcessGossipMessage"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [ProcessGossipMessage](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L248>)

```go
func (m *Manager) ProcessGossipMessage(msg *pubsub.Message, cryptoManager interfaces.CryptoManager, connectionManager interfaces.PeerManager)
```

ProcessGossipMessage processes a single gossip message for peer discovery. It handles lookup requests and responses, decrypting encrypted data if necessary and establishing connections to discovered peers.

<a name="Manager.ProcessLookupResponse"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [ProcessLookupResponse](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L411>)

```go
func (m *Manager) ProcessLookupResponse(resp *types.LookupResponse, connectionManager interfaces.PeerManager)
```

ProcessLookupResponse processes a lookup response received from another peer. It verifies the response signature if present and attempts to connect to the responding peer via the connection manager.

<a name="Manager.StartDHTDiscovery"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [StartDHTDiscovery](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L113>)

```go
func (m *Manager) StartDHTDiscovery()
```

StartDHTDiscovery starts periodic DHT\-based peer discovery. It advertises the node's presence on the GossipSub topic and periodically searches for other peers advertising on the same topic, attempting to connect to any discovered peers.

<a name="Manager.StartMDNSDiscovery"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [StartMDNSDiscovery](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L175>)

```go
func (m *Manager) StartMDNSDiscovery(connectionManager interfaces.PeerManager)
```

StartMDNSDiscovery starts mDNS\-based local network peer discovery. Discovered peers are automatically connected and added to the connection manager as background connections.

<a name="Manager.StartPeerDiscovery"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [StartPeerDiscovery](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L82>)

```go
func (m *Manager) StartPeerDiscovery(connectionManager interfaces.PeerManager)
```

StartPeerDiscovery initializes all enabled peer discovery mechanisms. It starts DHT bootstrap and discovery \(if enabled\) and mDNS discovery. The connectionManager is used to add discovered peers to tracking.

<a name="Manager.VerifyResponseSignature"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [VerifyResponseSignature](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/discovery/manager.go#L439>)

```go
func (m *Manager) VerifyResponseSignature(resp *types.LookupResponse) bool
```

VerifyResponseSignature verifies the cryptographic signature of a lookup response to ensure it was sent by the claimed peer. Returns true if the signature is valid, false otherwise.
